text_block_list.text:
One day, a letter from a fan arrives for
Meisho
Doto.

A f-fan letter? It... can't be for me,
right?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Maybe they got the names mixed up? I
mean,
there isn't one good thing about
me...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Why don't you try reading it first?

text_block_list.text:
I-I should, shouldn't I? Okay, here goes!
Um...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
"I love how hardworking you are. I'm
clumsy too,
so you give me courage."
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy... This is just like how I was
in the
past.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I remember listening to a post-race
interview and
hearing the winner say, "I
was able to overcome
my flaws."
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
It gave me courage, enough courage to
come to
this academy... And now, now
I'm the one who's...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Trainer, I promise to work even harder.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Because... despite my many flaws, I was
able to
encourage someone!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
From this day on, Мэйсё Дото puts in
far more
effort during our training
sessions.
